accused_gender.reason: The appellant is referred to with male pronouns throughout (e.g., 'his conviction').

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is stated in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.quote: The appellant was posted as a guard at the Police Station.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth, poverty or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim (constable Mohd. Rashid) is referred to with male pronouns.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not stated.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religion of the victim is stated or described.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: PW-12 and the appellant were annoyed with him and thus, threatened to kill him
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Co-worker relationship at the same station and the alleged grudge motive are both described in the judgment.

offence_category.correct_value: Other (causing death by negligence, IPC s.304A; initially charged as murder)
offence_category.quote: Section 302 of IPC was applied while filing the chargesheet.
offence_category.reason: Charged as murder, but the Court held it was not culpable homicide and finally convicted for negligence under s.304A.

statutory_provisions.quote: conviction u/s. 302 set aside ... guilty ... punishable u/s. 304A
statutory_provisions.reason: Covers the charged s.302 and the finally established s.304A; s.80 and s.6 are arguments, not charges.

weapon.reason: Semi-Automatic Fire carbine, described as 9 mm, is the weapon used.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness testimony, ballistic reports, circumstantial evidence and s.6 res gestae statements are all discussed.

confession.quote: the statement of an accused to which Section 6 is applicable cannot be treated as a confession of guilt
confession.reason: Court held the alleged statement is not a confession and was not relied on as one.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Gross negligence: appellant holding a sophisticated automatic weapon failed to keep the change lever in safety position
aggravating_circumstances.quote: there is a failure on the part of the appellant who was holding a sophisticated automatic weapon to ensure that the change lever was always kept in a safety position
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment notes gross negligence and failure to engage safety, which are aggravating facts, not 'None noted'.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Accidental firing and lack of intention or knowledge of likely death are noted by the Court.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The Trial Court sentenced the appellant to undergo a life sentence.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction under s.302 with life sentence matches the judgment.

high_court_outcome.quote: the conviction of the appellant has been confirmed
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed the conviction, which matches the value.

final_outcome.quote: the conviction of the appellant under Section 302 of the IPC is set aside and he is held guilty ... under Section 304A
final_outcome.reason: Conviction altered to a lesser offence, which is conviction_modified.

offence_finally_established.quote: guilty of committing the offence punishable under Section 304A of IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Final conviction is s.304A, causing death by negligence.

imprisonment_type.quote: The appellant has undergone the maximum sentence prescribed for the said offence.
imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence is a fixed-term sentence, effectively served as the prescribed maximum.

imprisonment_years.quote: the maximum sentence is imprisonment for two years
imprisonment_years.reason: Court states the maximum of two years has been undergone, so 2 years is supported.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers the incident, investigation and evidence without names or outcome; accurately reflects the judgment.

offence_severity.quote: for which the maximum sentence is imprisonment for two years
offence_severity.reason: Judgment states the maximum for s.304A is two years; no minimum is given.

attempt_completion.reason: Death resulted from the firing, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.quote: The deceased got five rounds of bullets in his neck.
physical_harm.reason: Death from five gunshot wounds, neck and chest, is described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 1 charged (s.302); 1 conviction stands (s.304A, lesser offence not charged)
number_of_offences.quote: Section 302 of IPC was applied while filing the chargesheet.
number_of_offences.reason: Only s.302 was charged; s.304A was a lesser-offence conviction, not an upheld charge.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.quote: The prosecution has failed to prove that the appellant had either any intention of causing the death
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found no intention to cause death; no planning was found.

motive.quote: the existence of motive does not inspire confidence
motive.reason: Alleged motive is marked as alleged and the Court held it was not established.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the version of PW-12 and PW-25 ... completely supports the defence of the appellant of accidental firing
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Eyewitness accounts, ballistic opinions and bullet injuries are the evidence the Court relied on.

witness_credibility.quote: PW-12 Shashi Bala was not declared as a hostile witness.
witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the Court's assessment of PW-12, PW-25, PW-22, PW-5 and PW-13.

post_offence_conduct.quote: assuming that the statements attributed to the appellant and PW-12 were in fact made
post_offence_conduct.reason: Court treated the alleged statement as relevant conduct only assuming it was made.

custody_duration.quote: the appellant had undergone incarceration for a period of about 8 years and 11 months
custody_duration.reason: Custody duration of about 8 years 11 months is stated.

bail_history.quote: released on bail by this Court by the order dated 27th November 2017
bail_history.reason: Supreme Court bail release on 27 November 2017 is stated.

trial_duration.quote: on 28th December 1994 ... the order dated 27th November 2017
trial_duration.reason: Offence date, High Court judgment date and Supreme Court date are given; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: S. Nagamuthu, Sr. Adv., Ms. Prerna Mehta, Adv. for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Appellant and respondent counsel match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.quote: an offence under Section 304A was registered ... investigation was transferred to the Crime Branch
investigation_status.reason: FIR under s.304A, transfer to Crime Branch, chargesheet under s.302 and completed trial are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.quote: the case of the prosecution that he intentionally opened fire by aiming at the deceased was not put to the appellant
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court noted the intentional-firing case was not put in the s.313 statement.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.quote: the appellant certainly had knowledge that the use of SAF carbine may cause death
prosecution_argument.reason: State's argument based on ballistic and ocular evidence is accurately stated.

defence_argument.quote: no offence was committed by the appellant in view of Section 80 of IPC
defence_argument.reason: Accidental firing, s.80 defence, alternative s.304 Part II and motive argument are all stated.

legal_principle_applied.quote: not a case of culpable homicide as defined u/s. 299
legal_principle_applied.reason: Court applied the s.299 culpable homicide test, gross negligence under s.304A and s.6 relevance.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: The judgment cites no precedents, so 'Not stated' is correct.

sentencing_rationale.quote: The appellant has undergone the maximum sentence prescribed for the said offence. Hence, his detention in prison is no longer required.
sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale for no further detention is accurately stated.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: The appellant has undergone a sentence of more than eight years.
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Accidental firing, lack of intention or knowledge, and time already served are noted by the Court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: there is gross negligence on the part of the appellant which led to a loss of human life
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Gross negligence with a sophisticated automatic weapon is the aggravating factor the Court weighed.

other_sentence_order.quote: Hence, his bail bonds are cancelled.
other_sentence_order.reason: Bail bond cancellation is the only other order stated.
